rows.headline: No clear control fault found; roll tracks its setpoint, pitch looks sign-inverted, airspeed is flat zero, and start-up warnings appear.
No control-surface fault found; one early low-voltage warning, roll lags setpoint about 1 s, and several recording artifacts.
No hard control fault found; roll lags setpoint about 1 s, and pitch diverged at start-up alongside a low-voltage warning and throttle cut.
No control-loop fault found; setpoint-led maneuvers tracked with ~1 s lag, but throttle dropped to 0% at 115.6 s unexplained.
Roll tracked its setpoint worse from t=5-15 s; the data shows a lag during hard maneuvers, not a clear fault.
No control fault found: attitude lags setpoint steps by about 1 s; low-battery warning and dead yaw-rate channel unexplained.
No control fault shown; roll tracks setpoint with ~1 s lag; start-up battery and sensor warnings unexplained.
Control fault likely: attitude/state estimates jump and lag setpoints after a sensor-health error at 1.5 s; location unproven.
Pitch loop on UAV-09 does not track its setpoint, while roll follows with lag; cause not isolated.
No clear control fault found; startup sensor and battery warnings plus estimator-like jumps are unexplained.
No control-loop fault found; low-voltage and sensor warnings at 0.9 s precede a throttle drop to zero.
No clear control fault found; pitch setpoint is inverted against attitude, and sensor/battery warnings sit at t=0.
Roll tracks large setpoint swings with a fixed lag; velocity and yaw estimates jump; low-voltage warning at 0.518 s.
No control fault found: roll and pitch follow commanded maneuvers with about 1 s lag; yaw error is a wrap artifact.
Pitch axis does not follow its setpoint (inverted, lagged response) while roll tracks; sensor-health error logged at t=1.264.
Roll tracking failed at start-up and at 9.7-13.3 s; the attitude response lags the setpoint by about 1 s.
No clear control fault: pitch and yaw mismatches look like convention or lag; sensor-health error and constant-zero signals remain open.
Roll and pitch lagged commands from t=0; low-voltage and sensor-health errors at 1.249 s; cause not separable.
No control-loop fault found; roll lags large setpoint swings by about 1 s, start-up warnings unexplained.
Pitch axis did not follow its setpoint; fault area is pitch control or estimate, cause not separable.
Pitch response is inverted against its setpoint from the start, while airspeed reads 0 all flight. Cause unknown.
No actuator fault seen; roll tracking errors are a ~1 s delay in attitude feedback, with sensor-health and low-voltage warnings at t=0.148.
Pitch control stopped following its setpoint late in the flight while throttle rose and altitude fell.
Pitch responded opposite to its command early on; ch[3] jumped to 1900 us at 55.238 s and pitch tracking degraded afterwards.
Control fault: output ch[3] saturated at 1900 from t=52.1 s; pitch tracking failed, also early at t=0.9-5.7 s.
Control fault at t≈60 s: actuator ch[3] output dropped to 1100 us and stayed there; pitch lost tracking.
Roll loop lagged its setpoint from about 125 s; actuator-side cause not separable from the recording
Roll control degraded from ~t=61 s; roll actuators 4/5 froze at 1500 us from 65.9 s; cause unresolved
No clear control-loop failure; start-up warnings and dead airspeed/yaw-rate channels point to sensor or power health.
Actuator output ch[4] froze at 1500 us from t=49.7 s while its twin ch[5] kept moving.
No clear control fault; roll lags setpoint by about 1 s, and a start-up sensor-health error is unexplained.
Longitudinal control fault: pitch moves opposite its setpoint twice, with airspeed reading a constant 0 all flight.
Roll setpoint flips between about ±44 deg and attitude follows late; sensor-health error and dead airspeed from start
Pitch loop diverged from setpoint at t=0.765 s, before the warnings; roll tracks only with a 1.477 s lag.
No attitude-control fault found; airspeed is dead and a sensor-health error was logged at start-up.
Roll tracking was poor in the first 18 s; no single control-fault onset or location is identifiable.
Roll/pitch diverge from setpoint at start and near 39–43 s, but the aircraft follows its setpoints with about 1 s lag; cause unknown.
Roll and yaw tracked poorly, with roll lagging its setpoint about 1 s; cause not separable from this recording
Heading estimate disagrees with setpoint and velocity from t=38 s; roll/pitch loop tracks its setpoint with lag.
Throttle commanded to 0% at t=76.07 s, then altitude loss; roll control tracked normally, cause of the cut unknown.
Throttle fell to 0 at t=104 s, then altitude dropped and pitch stopped tracking; cause not established
Throttle dropped to 0% late in the flight and the aircraft descended; cause of the cut is not in the data.
Sensor-health error at start, inverted pitch loop all flight, and throttle held at 0 from ~100 s; cause unknown.
Pitch diverged from setpoint at 1.197 s, 99.572 s and 111.163 s; roll tracked normally in mid-flight.
Throttle commanded to 0 at t=101.254 s, then pitch moved opposite its setpoint and altitude fell to 13.084 m.
Throttle dropped to 0% at 102 s and the aircraft lost 30 m of altitude; pitch and yaw are inverted all flight.
No clear control fault: pitch 'divergence' is sign/lag mismatch; low-voltage and sensor-health errors at 1.325 s unexplained.
No control fault shown; attitude loops track setpoints through aggressive manoeuvres, only start-up warnings recorded.
Throttle command dropped to zero at about 116 s with no recorded event, followed by loss of altitude and worse pitch tracking.
Throttle command dropped to 0 at 73.3 s and stayed there; motor channel ch2 followed, aircraft lost altitude.
Throttle commanded to 0% at 115.637 s and stayed there; aircraft lost most of its altitude before the end.
No control fault shown; roll, throttle and airspeed shifts follow commanded manoeuvres with steady tracking lag.
Throttle command dropped to zero at 113.146 s with no recorded event; altitude then fell from 50 m to 19 m.
Throttle command dropped to 0 at about 122-123 s and stayed there; ch[2] pinned at 1100 us, aircraft descended.
Throttle commanded to zero with no logged event; aircraft lost altitude and pitch tracking until throttle returned.
Throttle commanded to 0 at 91.9 s without any event; roll and pitch tracking degraded afterwards.
No control fault shown; roll divergence is a commanded manoeuvre, with a dead yaw_rate channel and start-up warnings left open.
Throttle command dropped to zero at ~117.2 s; motor channel ch[2] held 1100 us, aircraft lost airspeed and altitude.
Throttle commanded to 0 and held; ch2 followed to minimum, altitude fell.
Throttle commanded to 0 at about 131.8 s and stayed there; aircraft lost altitude. Origin of the cut is not in the recording.
Throttle commanded to 0% at 89.527 s and never recovered; altitude fell afterwards. Source of the cut not recorded.
Throttle commanded to zero at 103.3 s; the aircraft lost attitude control about 10 s later and descended.
No control fault found; attitude tracks setpoints, but yaw error is large and airspeed and yaw-rate channels are dead.
Throttle command dropped to zero at ~104.9 s with no mode event, and held to the end; altitude fell afterwards.
Throttle cut to 0 at t=49.81 s with no event; attitude tracking degraded from 55.7 s.
No control fault shown: roll deviations follow commanded setpoint steps; only start-up warnings and flat airspeed/yaw-rate channels stand out.
Roll-loop output ch[1] froze at 1500 us at t=118.123 s while roll demand kept varying; pitch tracking degraded near it.
Outputs ch[4] and ch[5] each froze at neutral mid-flight, ch[4] first, with no event or tracking loss
Actuator channel 1 (roll loop) froze at 1500 us from 63.483 s; pitch tracking degraded afterwards.
Control fault late in flight: pitch tracking degraded from t≈51.7 s, then throttle froze and ch[7] stepped at ≈59 s
Output ch[3] pegged at 1900 us from 55.637 s; roll tracking then collapsed, cause unknown
Output channel 3 (pitch-loop surface) froze at 1900 us at t=52.142 s; roll and yaw tracking degraded afterwards.
Pitch-loop output ch3 froze at 1100 us at 60.4 s; attitude tracking degraded from 58.3 s
Outputs ch[3] and ch[4] froze at 1500 us at t=116.327 s while ch[5] and the setpoints kept moving.
Roll-control outputs ch4/ch5 froze at neutral 1500 at t=65.92 s; roll and yaw tracking then failed.
Actuator output ch[5] froze at 1500 us late in the flight while ch[4] and the attitude loops kept running.
Actuator output ch[4] froze at 1500 us from 49.7 s with no event; attitude still tracked afterwards.
No control fault shown: shifts follow commanded setpoint changes and attitude tracking holds after start-up.
Output channel 5 froze at 1500 us at t=152 s while its twin channel 4 kept moving; cause not shown.
No control fault shown: roll follows setpoint swings; yaw and airspeed signals look like recording artefacts.
Actuator ch[5] froze at 1500 us from t=73.43 s; control degradation after it is not proven to follow.
Actuator output ch[4] froze at 1500 us from t=72.47 s while other channels kept moving
No roll-loop fault; yaw setpoint froze at 44 deg at t=83.3 s with no recorded cause
No control fault shown; attitude followed setpoints, and only start-up warnings and a dead airspeed channel stand out.
Throttle command dropped 49% to 0 at t=48.9 s and stayed zero; aircraft then lost about 30 m of altitude.
Throttle was commanded to 0% at t=100.47 s; ch2 followed, altitude fell, and no event or mode change explains the cut.
Throttle command dropped to 0% at t=76 s and stayed there; altitude then fell.
Throttle command dropped to 0 at ~104 s with no event; ch[2] followed, aircraft lost altitude.
Throttle command dropped to 0 at t=110.797 s with no recorded cause; the aircraft then lost altitude and control tracking.
Throttle command dropped to 0 at t=100.5 s with no event; the throttle motor output followed and the aircraft then lost altitude.
Throttle command dropped to 0 at 98.3 s and stayed there; ch2 followed it; pitch loop degraded from about 106 s.
Throttle commanded to 0 at 101.25 s; motor channel 2 followed and the aircraft lost altitude.
Throttle command dropped to 0 at 102.171 s and stayed there; motor output followed and the aircraft lost altitude.
No control-loop fault found; airspeed and yaw-rate channels read constant zero all flight, a sensor-data problem.
Airspeed reads 0 all flight and yaw rate is stuck at 0; throttle and pitch oscillate, ending in a descent.
Throttle dropped to 0% at t=116 s; motor channel ch2 went to minimum and stayed there while airspeed and altitude fell.
Throttle/motor output ch[2] dropped to minimum at 74 s and stayed there; aircraft slowed and lost altitude.
No clear control fault; throttle channel 2 pinned at idle from 117 s while altitude fell to 6.6 m
No control fault found; attitude tracks setpoints, though yaw-rate reads a constant 0 and a battery warning was logged.
No attitude-control fault; throttle cut to 0% at t=115 s with channel 2 pinned at 1100 us, cause unknown.
Throttle cut to 0% at t=123s; motor output ch[2] followed to 1100us, attitude control stayed normal.
Throttle channel 2 dropped to idle at 117 s; pitch then failed to track setpoint from about 126 s while descending.
Throttle/motor channel 2 dropped to minimum for 14 s (t=92–105) in flight while the aircraft lost altitude.
No control fault found; setpoints tracked, but yaw-rate reads zero and a sensor-health error is logged at start.
Propulsion output ch[2] and throttle dropped to minimum twice, at t=2-9s and from t=118s, and the aircraft lost airspeed and altitude.
Throttle channel ch[2] pinned at minimum from t=88 s with throttle 0%, while attitude control stayed normal.
Motor/throttle channel ch[2] dropped to minimum at t=134 s and stayed there, with altitude falling 50 to 9 m.
Throttle channel ch[2] dropped to minimum 1100 us at t=91 s and stayed there, so the aircraft descended unpowered.
Throttle output ch[2] cut to minimum at t=103-104 s and stayed there; aircraft lost altitude until end of log.
No actuator control fault seen; airspeed and yaw-rate read zero all flight after a sensor-health error at 0.2 s.
Throttle collapsed to 0% at t=105 s; propulsion channel ch[2] stuck at minimum while aircraft lost altitude.
Throttle drops to zero at t=50 s with motor channel ch[2] at minimum; aircraft descends, ch[1] drifts.
No control fault found; attitude tracked setpoints, but airspeed and yaw rate read constant zero from t=0.
Pitch-axis control loss from t≈119 s; actuator ch[2] and pitch diverged, altitude fell 57 to 36 m.
Actuator ch[4]/ch[5] pair desynchronised: ch[4] pinned at 1500 us from t≈106 s, ch[5] from t≈177 s.
Pitch control lost from about t=73 s: nose-down divergence and altitude loss despite ch[2] saturated at 1700 us
Pitch control lost authority from about t=58 s: ch1 and ch2 saturated, ch7 jumped, aircraft sank.
Output channel 3 jumped to 1900 us at t=56 s and stayed there; the other channels compensated.
Actuator output channel 3 stuck at 1900 us from t=52 s; attitude control degraded afterwards.
Actuator output ch[3] dropped to 1100 us at t=61 s and stayed there; the other channels compensated.
From about t=117 s, actuator ch[5] diverged from ch[4], which froze at 1500 us, and roll control became abnormal.
Outputs ch4 and ch5 froze at exactly 1500 us from about t=66 s, then roll control degraded and diverged.
Actuator output ch[5] froze at 1500 us from t=112 s while its twin ch[4] kept moving.
Output channel 4 froze at 1500 us from about t=50 s while paired channel 5 kept moving.
No control-loop fault seen; sensor-health error at 0.2 s with airspeed and yaw-rate flat at zero all flight
Actuator channel 5 froze at 1500 us at t=153 s while its twin channel 4 kept moving; altitude then fell.
No control fault found; aircraft tracked setpoints, only startup battery and sensor warnings logged at 0.2 s.
Actuator channel 5 froze at 1500 us from about t=74 s while paired channel 4 kept responding.
Actuator ch4 output froze at 1500 us from t=73 s while twin ch5 kept moving; ch7 stepped at t=95 s.
No actuator control fault seen; yaw-rate and airspeed read zero all flight, matching the t=0 sensor error.
No actuator or controller failure found; sensor-health error at 1 s and a large setpoint excursion at 0-4 s.
Throttle cut to zero at t=49 s; motor channel 2 pinned at 1100 us, aircraft descended 50 to 18 m.
At t=101 s throttle drops to 0 and output ch[2] pins at 1100 us; altitude falls from 49 m to 25 m.
Output ch[2] dropped to 1100 us and stayed there from t=77 s, after throttle fell to 0 at t=76 s; aircraft lost altitude.
Propulsion cut at 104 s: throttle and motor channel 2 dropped to minimum and stayed there while the aircraft descended.
Throttle dropped to 0 at 111 s; output ch[2] pinned at 1100 us from 112 s, ch[1] from 121 s, altitude falling.
Throttle channel ch[2] and propulsion dropped to minimum at t=101s and stayed there, with altitude falling afterwards.
Throttle and output ch[2] dropped to minimum at t=99 s and stayed there; altitude then fell.
Propulsion cut at t=102 s: output ch[2] dropped to 1100 us, throttle fell to 0, aircraft descended.
Propulsion lost at t=102 s: throttle 0%, ch[2] pinned at 1100 us, aircraft descended 49 m to 18 m.
No actuator control fault found; sensor-health error at 1.3 s and stuck airspeed and yaw-rate signals.
